images.prompt: Create a standalone painted illustration for a collectible Kalistar weapon card. Input 1 is the EXACT weapon identity reference: Hache du Roi Dechu, a single broad worn steel axe blade with copper/gold Celtic geometric inlay and a split broken-crown motif, brown wood haft with leather grip and copper pommel. Preserve its silhouette, materials and engravings. Input 2 (Momo) and input 3 (Valazar) are ONLY painting style references: narrative fantasy painting, visible purposeful brushwork, tactile worn materials, absolutely no photo or smooth 3D render. Show the axe alone leaning diagonally against a weathered stone throne fragment in a quiet red-grey mountain canyon at dawn. Its weight, age and lost royal dignity should be felt. The axe fills most of the central/right area and is fully visible, head upper right, haft toward lower left, with clear copper glints and bright readable cutting edge. Small drifts of dust and a faded piece of fabric, restrained evocative background. NO person, NO hand, NO medallion, NO card frame, NO writing, NO symbols except the axe's existing engraved broken crown. Portrait-near-square composition about 4:5, the weapon within the middle 75 percent with breathing room. Leave the middle far left relatively calm where the UI will later place a separate small medallion. Art only; rich, collectible trading-card illustration.

Create a standalone painted illustration for a collectible Kalistar weapon card: La Flute des Petits Bonheurs. Input 1 is the exact existing weapon identity reference: a real transverse silver flute with brass/gold engravings, distinct mechanical keys, blue luminous key pads, tiny golden details and pale blue electric incandescence. Preserve this identity and credible flute construction, show the entire instrument once. Input 2 (Momo) and input 3 (Valazar) are PAINTING STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: detailed narrative fantasy painting, visible brush strokes and color planes, patinated materials, NO photographic look or smooth 3D. Scene: Momo has left his flute gently across a worn folded cloth on a low old repair bench on a Chroma rooftop. This is a futuristic cyberpunk city, not medieval; only a subtle hint of old cables, one repaired little brass wind-up music toy and distant muted city windows behind. The FLUTE is large and dominant, diagonally from lower left to upper right in the central/right 75 percent, fully visible with space at both ends. Delicate pale blue electrical filaments caress it and warm tiny golden sparks suggest the surrounding broken things briefly becoming happier. Warm tender evening light, cool silver readable against muted teal and warm worn wood. No aggressive explosion, no notes drawn as symbols, no hands or people, no second flute. Portrait composition about 4:5. Leave middle far left relatively calm for a separate UI medallion. NO card frame, NO text, NO interface, NO numbers, NO watermark.
